title.narrative: for support of Stronger Community Organizations for Reproductive Equity (SCORE)

description.narrative: This grant will support DSW Kenya, an advocacy organization that works to ensure that young people are empowered to lead healthy and self-determined lives. Through core funding, capacity strengthening, and peer education, DSW Kenya will implement the Stronger Community Organizations for Reproductive Equity (SCORE) project by partnering with diverse youth-led organizations. This partnership will focus on four Kenyan counties — Kwale, Kilifi, Mombasa, and West Pokot — where disparities in access to reproductive health care are most pronounced in the country. DSW Kenya and its partners will amplify the voices of young people on reproductive equity and dismantle the barriers that prevent equitable access to essential reproductive health care services. (Strategy: Global Reproductive Equity)
